description: This Java source file defines an abstract assertion class for Event objects, providing various helper methods for validation in testing scenarios within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: AbstractEventAssert
classes.description: An abstract assertion class for Event objects providing validation methods for properties such as headers, IDs, entity contents, resource paths, type, name, revision, and timestamp.

methods.name: AbstractEventAssert
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the assertion object with an Event instance and the specific subclass type.

methods.name: hasDittoHeaders
methods.description: Asserts that the Event has the expected DittoHeaders.

methods.name: hasCorrelationId
methods.description: Asserts that the Event has the expected correlation ID in its headers.

methods.name: hasId
methods.description: Asserts that the Event's EntityId matches the expected ID, either as a CharSequence or EntityId.

methods.name: hasEntity
methods.description: Asserts that the Event contains the specified JsonValue entity, optionally checking against a schema version.

methods.name: hasNoEntity
methods.description: Asserts that the Event has no entity.

methods.name: hasResourcePath
methods.description: Asserts that the Event's resource path matches the expected JsonPointer.

methods.name: hasManifest
methods.description: Asserts that the Event's manifest matches the expected value.

methods.name: hasType
methods.description: Asserts that the Event's type matches the expected string.

methods.name: hasName
methods.description: Asserts that the Event's name matches the expected string.

methods.name: hasRevision
methods.description: Asserts that the Event's revision number matches the expected value.

methods.name: hasTimestamp
methods.description: Asserts that the Event's timestamp matches the expected Instant.
